pages.text: I can call a unique superior undead mount.

$(bold)Mana:$() 3 buckets$(br)$(bold)Mode:$() Instant$(br2)Cast toward a valid placement within eight blocks. If my active steed already exists, the spell recalls it rather than creating another. The bound Skeleton Horse is tamed to me with forty health, 0.32 movement speed, and 0.9 jump strength.
pages.title: Method and Limits
